fullDescription: A high-impact 'Brutalist Luxury' design system featuring a dark-mode palette, glassmorphism UI elements, and massive editorial typography. Optimized for creative agencies, design portfolios, and premium tech brands. The style utilizes a deep background (#060606) contrasted with crisp white text and frosted glass components with blur effects. Key features include scroll-triggered reveal animations, large-scale display text using Bebas Neue, and a sophisticated navigation pill structure.
prompt:
## Resumo
Agencia is a minimalist, luxury-brutalist design system that pairs aggressive typographic scales with refined glassmorphic interactive elements and smooth, physics-based scroll animations.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design system with a background color of #060606 and a text selection color of #0000ee. Typography: Primary display font 'Bebas Neue' (uppercase, tracking 0.02em to 0.2em) for headings; Body font 'Inter' (weights 400, 500, 600). Color Palette: Background #060606, Surface #111111, Muted Text #808080, Borders #151515. Glassmorphism: Use backdrop-filter blur (12px - 20px) with background rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) and borders rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2). Animations: Reveal animations should use cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1) over 0.8s. Shadows: Subtle 0_20px_60px_rgba(0,0,0,0.3) for glass elements. Spotlight effect: A radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) 0%, transparent 70%) overlay on the hero.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Fixed Navigation
Create a floating navigation bar with three distinct zones: a logo on the left, a central pill-shaped nav-menu, and a CTA on the right. The central pill should have a backdrop blur of 20px, background rgba(21, 21, 21, 0.8), and rounded-full corners. Navigation links inside should have a hover underline effect that expands from the left. The right-side 'Chat' button must be glassmorphic (white/10 background) with a circular white arrow icon that slides on hover.

### Hero Section
A full-height hero section with a centered video background (75% brightness). Feature massive display text (font-size: 15rem or 'agencia-text') in white. Include a sub-heading and a large primary glassmorphic CTA button (padding: 2.5rem 1.25rem). At the bottom of the hero, include a horizontal list of services in Bebas Neue (size: 2xl, color: white/30) that fade in from the right.

### Content Reveal Section
Design a section featuring a 'text-reveal-mask' animation. Use a massive font (size: 14rem, tracking: 0.2em) that reveals itself via a clip-path (inset(0 100% 0 0) to inset(0 0 0 0)) upon scroll. Follow this with a two-column grid: a left-aligned text description (max-width: 448px, color: white/60) and right-aligned social links in circular borders (48px x 48px).

### Footer
A clean, minimal footer with a top border of white/5. Include a copyright tag in uppercase (tracking-widest, text-xs) and a set of utility links on the right. All links should use the nav-link hover underline interaction.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Glassmorphic Primary Button — A pill-shaped button with a frosted glass effect and interactive icon.
Apply background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); border-radius: 9999px; transition: scale 0.3s, background 0.3s. On hover, scale to 1.05 and change background to rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2). Inside, a white 32px circle contains a black icon that translates +4px on the X-axis during hover.

### Decorative Background Text — Large-scale background year or branding text that reveals on scroll.
Position a huge heading (font-size: 18rem, color: white/5) at the bottom right of a section. Apply a scroll-reveal animation that starts with opacity: 0 and translateY: 30px, transitioning to active state on scroll trigger.

## Notas Especiais
MUST use 'backdrop-filter: blur' for all interactive buttons to maintain the glassmorphism aesthetic. DO NOT use vibrant background colors; stick to #060606 to ensure the white and glass elements pop. Typography MUST be Bebas Neue for all display elements and Inter for legibility. Maintain the 0.8s cubic-bezier animation for all scroll-triggered reveals to ensure a 'premium' feel.

style.description: The style is defined by its high-contrast dark theme (#060606) and the use of 'Bebas Neue' for massive, uppercase display headings and 'Inter' for clean body copy. It features a heavy reliance on 'glassmorphism' (backdrop-filter: blur(12px to 20px)) for primary UI elements. Interactive states are marked by white-to-black inversions and smooth scale transformations (cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)). A subtle spotlight radial gradient and a #0000ee (vibrant blue) selection color add depth to the dark palette.
